## Checklist
- [ ] `ruff check src tests`, `mypy src` and `pytest` pass / pasan
- [ ] Tests added or updated / Tests añadidos o actualizados
- [ ] Docs updated (README EN/ES) if behaviour changed / Docs actualizadas si cambia el comportamiento
- [ ] No tokens, exports or customer data included / Sin tokens, exportaciones ni datos de clientes
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`…) / Commits en formato Conventional Commits
